test_title: PYST 17: RRB NTPC (UG) CBT-I - GA (Held On: 14 Aug, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Under guidance of which of the following organisations were the civil defence mock drills conducted under Operation Shield in Haryana in May 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Union Ministry of Home Affairs**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Operation Shield** was conducted under the guidance of the **Union Ministry of Home Affairs** in Haryana in May 2025 to ensure preparedness for emergency situations, especially for civil defence.
 
• The initiative involved **mock drills** to train individuals and agencies on how to effectively respond to disasters, including natural calamities and man-made emergencies.
 
• The **Union Ministry of Home Affairs** is responsible for overseeing civil defence activities in India and provides guidelines and support for disaster preparedness and response.
 
• Such mock drills are vital for assessing the readiness of emergency services and ensuring coordination among various departments during crises.
 
• The involvement of the Union Ministry of Home Affairs highlights the importance of centralized planning and resources in addressing emergencies effectively.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Union Ministry of Home Affairs:**

 
 
• The Ministry is the nodal agency for managing **internal security, disaster response, and civil defence** in India.
 
• It coordinates activities related to disaster management, including **preparedness, mitigation, and response**.
 
• It provides **funding and technical support** to state governments for conducting training programs and mock drills.
 
• It administers the **Disaster Management Act, 2005**, which lays the foundation for disaster preparedness and management in India.
 
 
 
• **National Disaster Management Authority (NDMA):**
 
 
• The NDMA was established under the **Disaster Management Act, 2005**, and is responsible for formulating policies for disaster preparedness and response.
 
• It works in close coordination with the Union Ministry of Home Affairs and state governments.
 
• The NDMA also provides **guidelines for conducting mock drills and disaster management exercises**.
 
 
 
• **Civil Defence:**
 
 
• Civil Defence refers to activities aimed at protecting the civilian population and infrastructure during emergencies.
 
• The **Civil Defence Act, 1968**, empowers the government to undertake preparedness and training measures for disaster response.
 
• It includes training volunteers, conducting awareness campaigns, and organizing mock drills like **Operation Shield**.
 
 
 
• **Disaster Preparedness:**
 
 
• Disaster preparedness involves measures taken to reduce the impact of disasters, including training, planning, and resource allocation.
 
• Mock drills and simulation exercises help in identifying gaps in preparedness and improving coordination among agencies.
 
• Preparedness activities are essential for ensuring quick and efficient response during emergencies.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Key Legal Framework:**

 
 
• The **Disaster Management Act, 2005**, provides a legal framework for disaster management in India.
 
• The **Civil Defence Act, 1968**, outlines the roles and responsibilities of civil defence agencies.
 
 
 
• **Role of Union Ministry of Home Affairs:**
 
 
• The Ministry oversees the implementation of disaster management policies and coordinates with state governments.
 
• It ensures availability of **resources and technical expertise** for disaster response.
 
 
 
• **Mock Drills:**
 
 
• Mock drills are simulation exercises conducted to assess preparedness and response capabilities during emergencies.
 
• They involve **training personnel, testing equipment, and improving coordination** among agencies.
